name: appium-flutter
description: Appium Flutter-driver end-to-end tests for the RunLoyal kiosk app

scripts.test: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --test tests/kiosk/suite.test.js; s=$?; node scripts/build-report.js; exit $s
scripts.test:separate-sessions: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/kiosk/login.test.js tests/kiosk/clock-in-out.test.js tests/kiosk/clock-in-wrong-credentials.test.js; s=$?; node scripts/build-report.js; exit $s
scripts.test:login: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --test tests/kiosk/login.test.js; s=$?; node scripts/build-report.js; exit $s
scripts.test:clock-in: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --test tests/kiosk/clock-in-out.test.js; s=$?; node scripts/build-report.js; exit $s
scripts.test:android: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --test tests/kiosk/android-suite.test.js; s=$?; node scripts/build-report.js; exit $s
scripts.test:android:login: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --test tests/shared/staff-login.test.js; s=$?; node scripts/build-report.js; exit $s
scripts.test:kiosk-main: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --test tests/kiosk/kiosk-main.test.js; s=$?; node scripts/build-report.js; exit $s
scripts.test:new-client: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --test tests/kiosk/new-client.test.js; s=$?; node scripts/build-report.js; exit $s
scripts.test:new-client:write: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --test tests/kiosk/new-client-write.test.js; s=$?; node scripts/build-report.js; exit $s
